title: Basecamp™️ Dog Bowl Mat
productIdentity: Ruff Wear Inc: Basecamp™️ Dog Bowl Mat

excerpts.text: Adventures begin at basecamp, and the Basecamp™ Dog Bowl Mat is where your canine sidekick can go to refresh and refuel for the next excursion to the mountains, river, or trail.
This food and water bowl footprint has a recycled TPE-coated grip base and sturdy walls for containing spills and withstanding being stepped on by eager dogs.
It fits two bowls side-by-side and features a topo map design to inspire future outdoor explorations.
Exterior: 20.5 in x 12.5 in x 1.25 in (52 x 32 x 3 cm)Interior: 18 in x 10.25 in x 1 in (46 x 26 x 2.5 cm)
